summary.text: Randy Deibert is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 31 who took office on January 10, 2023, succeeding Timothy R. Johns, and a land surveyor.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Deibert's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as a land surveyor with Professional Mapping and Surveying, LLC.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Retirement Laws Committee and the Senate Transportation Committee, and he also serves on the Senate Commerce and Energy and State Affairs committees and the Senate Legislative Procedure Committee.
In 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.
